baseline_models.focus_anchor: The class named by al-qawa'id is further delimited by la yarjuna nikahan before the no-blame formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled withdrawal from menstruation or marriage combines with absence of marital expectation to define a life-stage class; negation of junah then grants that class a real concession rather than merely describing old age.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally names a woman who has ceased menstruation or marriage and supplies the settled life-stage category.
Hope as the heart's orientation toward an expected good makes marital prospect, not age alone, the operative delimiter.
Marriage and its contract identify the prospect said no longer to organize this class's dress burden.
The frozen negator removes a present predicate of liability.
Junah as inclination into sin or constriction makes its negation an explicit release from blame.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a generic rule for elderly women.
changed_reading.after: The ayah gives a status-based concession to women whose marital expectation has ceased; it does not reduce the class to age or incapacity alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: An yada'na thiyabahunna is immediately bounded by ghayra mutabarrijatin bi-zinah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Laying aside a garment layer is permitted, but the circumstantial exclusion keeps the act outside deliberate adornment-display. The object relaxed is a dress burden; the visual-social boundary remains active.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies a woman's laying aside of a covering and gives the permitted action its garment-specific force.
Clothing or covering is the concrete layer affected, rather than the body being made generally public.
Exclusion and negation separate the permitted laying-aside from the disallowed manner of display.
Tabarruj literally contributes showing adornment in a desire-attracting way and defines the prohibited social effect.
Adornment names what is made visually salient and therefore limits how the clothing concession may be used.

changed_reading.before: The women may remove their clothes.
changed_reading.after: They may lay aside a garment layer without turning the relaxation into adornment-display; reduced dress burden is not unrestricted exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wa-an yasta'fifna khayrun lahunna follows, rather than replaces, laysa alayhinna junah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-restraint is ranked as more beneficial after a valid permission has already been stated. The sequence creates an ethical preference within legal latitude, not a covert cancellation of the concession.

activation_trace.role: Restraint from what is unfitting supplies the voluntary conduct preferred after permission.
Beneficial good ranks restraint as advantageous without converting the preceding release from blame into prohibition.

changed_reading.before: Calling restraint better retracts the permission in practice.
changed_reading.after: The ayah preserves a real permission while preferring continued restraint as the more beneficial choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated non-display of adornment in 24:31, together with a covering drawn over the garment opening, places 24:60 inside an existing visibility system. The later concession adjusts one clothing layer for a delimited class while retaining that system's control of deliberate display.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and becoming visible supply the public-facing action repeatedly restricted around adornment.
The three adornment occurrences establish the same regulated object that qualifies the focus concession.
Covering and concealment provide the garment operation against which the later laying-aside is a controlled relaxation.
The shirt opening makes the earlier covering rule spatially specific rather than an abstract demand for invisibility.
The focus prohibition on adornment-display preserves the earlier visibility logic inside the concession.

structural_cues: 24:31 regulates whether adornment appears, where covering falls, and before whom appearance occurs; 24:60 repeats adornment while changing the garment rule for one class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated adornment/nonappearance and a concrete covering operation; I infer that 24:60 relaxes a layer within that architecture. A live alternative is that 24:60 is an independent age-specific rule whose shared vocabulary does less structural work.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause independently reduces clothing requirements for an older group.
changed_reading.after: The clause recalibrates the surah's established adornment-visibility system for a later-life class while preserving its anti-display boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 24:33, inability to obtain marriage activates abstinence until the horizon opens; in 24:60, absence of expected marriage permits dress relief while abstinence remains better. The repeated root pair makes self-restraint a discipline that spans both the not-yet and no-longer marriage horizons.

activation_trace.role: Causing others to marry supplies the positive communal opening of the marriage horizon.
Active restraint from what is unfitting governs those for whom marriage is not presently available.
Marriage is the unavailable state around which the earlier command of restraint is temporally organized.
The focus removes expectation of marriage rather than merely delaying access to it.
The same restraint persists as a preferred option after the marriage horizon has closed.

structural_cues: 24:32 opens marriage, 24:33 commands restraint where marriage is unavailable, and 24:60 repeats both marriage and restraint under a no-longer-expecting condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated marriage/restraint pair under opposite temporal conditions; I supply the life-course mirror linking not-yet availability to no-longer expectation. The alternative is ordinary lexical reuse without a deliberate endpoint symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The final call to restraint is a generic intensification of modesty.
changed_reading.after: It is the later-life counterpart of 24:33's marriage-conditioned discipline: the concession changes, but voluntary self-command remains valuable across both ends of the marriage horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: 24:58 uses the exact laying-down/clothes root pair for a midday privacy interval and surrounds it with permission-to-enter rules. This makes garment-laying a situated threshold event. In 24:60 the governing condition changes from time of day to life stage, while the no-display clause still controls access.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization regulate who may cross the boundary during garment-laying.
A thing's appointed time makes the clothes-laying explicitly situational.
Putting something down supplies the same physical action used in the focus.
Clothing is the same direct object laid aside in the focus construction.
The concealed private zone explains why access must be managed when clothing is laid down.
The focus narrows the shared putting-down action to a woman's garment relaxation.

structural_cues: 24:58 places clothes-laying inside three named privacy intervals and an entry-permission regime.
24:58 and 24:60 both follow the garment construction with a no-blame formula, but each supplies a different boundary condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root-pair recurrence and explicit access controls; I infer that the recurrence imports boundary sensitivity into 24:60, not the midday schedule itself. A live alternative is that the focus grants an enduring wardrobe option with no event-like force.

changed_reading.before: The focus grants a permanent reduction in clothing quantity.
changed_reading.after: The focus grants a life-stage-conditioned ability to relax a garment boundary, analogous to the time-conditioned garment relaxation of 24:58, while still governing exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, reaching puberty moves children into the full permission regime. The focus then names a later-life class and recalibrates its dress rule. Privacy obligations therefore appear as stage-sensitive thresholds rather than a single undifferentiated burden.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at an endpoint supplies the transition into a new privacy status.
The young child supplies the pre-threshold class whose rule is about to change.
Attaining puberty names the threshold that activates the adult permission practice.
Repeated permission-seeking is the obligation recalibrated at puberty.
The settled woman beyond menstruation or marriage supplies the later threshold class.

structural_cues: The adjacent sequence moves from children crossing into adult privacy obligations in 24:59 to women receiving a later-life dress concession in 24:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent life-stage categories with changed privacy rules; I infer a lifecycle symmetry. The alternative is simple topical adjacency without an intended symmetry between puberty and later-life settlement.

changed_reading.before: Qawa'id marks frailty as an isolated exception.
changed_reading.after: Qawa'id marks the far side of a lifecycle privacy threshold: the surah increases obligations at puberty and selectively relaxes a garment burden after marital expectation has ceased.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere the same laysa/junah formula grants workable exceptions for entry, household circulation, and eating, while haraj similarly names removed constraint. Its recurrence confirms that 24:60's release is operative; the preference for restraint guides use of the permission rather than erasing it.

activation_trace.role: Negation removes liability from entering a specified class of uninhabited houses.
The sin-or-constraint branch gives the entry exception real exculpatory force.
Negation opens ordinary circulation after the three privacy intervals.
No blame marks the outside-of-threshold circulation as genuinely permitted.
The repeated negator introduces both status-sensitive relief and a social-eating permission.
The same no-blame idiom authorizes eating together or separately.
Repeated sin or scruple language supplies the parallel removal of constriction from named bodily conditions.
Calling restraint beneficial ranks conduct inside the established permission rather than reversing its no-blame status.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly uses negated junah to state exceptions and then retains surrounding boundary rules.
24:58, 24:60, and 24:61 form a local run of relief formulas for privacy, dress, and social access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent syntax with clearly permissive applications; I infer stable exculpatory force in the focus. The alternative is that khayrun lahunna pragmatically narrows use more strongly than the other exceptions, though it still cannot grammatically erase no blame.

changed_reading.before: The permission is nominal and the recommendation effectively restores the full rule.
changed_reading.after: The no-blame formula grants real latitude, while the recommendation identifies a better use of freedom rather than cancelling it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating clothing as a portable house boundary is a cross-domain analogy, not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in the focus garment, laying-aside, and anti-display construction and in the surah's branch-backed house-entry permissions; downstream prose should present it as a spatial model of regulated access.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yada'na thiyabahunna changes a worn boundary, while ghayra mutabarrijatin prevents the change from becoming open display.

activation_trace.role: Entering an interior supplies the crossing action in the spatial analogy.
The dwelling supplies an interior protected by an access boundary.
Authorization governs whether the protected boundary may be crossed.
The garment supplies the wearable boundary whose placement changes.
The ban on adornment-display prevents relaxation of the wearable boundary from becoming unrestricted public access.

changed_reading.before: The clause only changes how much clothing is worn.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the garment functions like a portable privacy threshold: it may be relaxed for this class, but the interior/public distinction remains controlled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pregnancy and childbirth branches are form-distant from the surface senses of hope and garment removal, so this is not a legal or lexical replacement reading. The echo remains anchored in qawa'id, marriage expectation, and yada'na; downstream prose should label it only as a symbolic life-course resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A class settled beyond menstruation or marriage, no longer expecting marriage, is permitted to yada'na a covering.

activation_trace.role: The woman beyond menstruation, offspring, or marriage supplies the closed reproductive-marital horizon.
The branch image of a pregnant carrier nearing delivery contributes an exploratory counter-image to the focus's negated expectation.
Marriage supplies the life-course institution whose expected future has ended.
Laying down a pregnancy contributes the distant image of releasing a carried burden at a life-stage transition.

changed_reading.before: Laying aside clothing is only a practical wardrobe concession.
changed_reading.after: As a contained symbolic echo, the garment-laying can resonate with laying down a completed reproductive-marital burden once that horizon is no longer expected.

strongest_changes: 24:31 turns the focus from an isolated age exception into a calibrated relaxation within the surah's adornment-visibility system.
24:33 makes continued self-restraint the later-life mirror of discipline while marriage is not yet available.
24:58's exact laying-down/clothes recurrence makes the focus concession a regulated privacy-threshold event, and the repeated no-blame formula confirms that the latitude is real.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed a lifecycle architecture: privacy obligations intensify at puberty, garment access is time-conditioned in the household, and one dress burden relaxes after marital expectation ceases without dissolving the anti-display boundary.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports a garment or covering layer but does not by itself settle the exact item denoted by thiyab.
The not-yet/no-longer marriage symmetry and puberty/later-life symmetry are reader-supplied structural inferences rather than explicit equations.
The portable-boundary and reproductive-laying-down readings should remain qualified exploratory resonances.
